items.title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
items.summary: System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass. This makes them fast and cheap, but when they choose wrongly there is nothing to inspect: did the model misread what the agent has seen, or read it correctly and still act wrongly? We answer behaviorally. On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual prob
items.summary_zh: 该研究通过冻结基准评估 System One 模型在智能体循环中的决策失误，区分是感知错误还是执行错误。
items.why_zh: 属于智能体决策诊断技能，可学习如何通过行为实验区分感知与执行错误，提升 Agent 可靠性。

items.title: Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments
items.summary: Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world. However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments. We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system conn
items.summary_zh: 提出基准测试 LLMs 在真实物理环境中的工具调用与决策能力，超越静态文本评估。
items.why_zh: 属于 LLM 与物理交互评估技能，可学习如何构建真实世界任务基准，评估模型的工具使用与决策。

items.title: Let the Mind Conceive, Let the Hand Achieve: Following Multimodal Instructions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: A robot following a multi-step instruction needs to act on the right objects in the right order, even as the scene changes. It must also maintain awareness of task progress and determine when to advance. To address these challenges, we introduce Orchestra, an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation. Orchestra decomposes a complete multimodal instruction into ordered subtasks, tracks completed steps, and updates the locations of relevant objects
items.summary_zh: 提出 Orchestra 框架，分离任务规划与执行管理，使机器人能够依据多模态指令完成长序列操作。
items.why_zh: 属于多模态任务规划与执行解耦技能，可学习如何设计分层 Agent 架构以处理长 horizon 机器人任务。

items.title: How to Use Meta’s Rebalancer for Task Placement & Optimization
items.summary: In this comprehensive coding tutorial, we explore Meta's Rebalancer assignment solver using its C++ core and Python bindings. Learn how to build datacenters, manage task placements across racks, handle constraints and goal priorities, and compare local search against the exact HiGHS solver using published benchmarks. The post How to Use Meta’s Rebalancer for Task Placement & Optimization appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 使用 Meta 的 Rebalancer（C++核心+Python绑定）进行任务放置与优化，构建数据中心机架任务分配，处理约束与优先级，并与 HiGHS 求解器基准比较。
items.why_zh: 学习约束求解与局部搜索在任务调度中的应用，掌握 C++核心+Python绑定的混合开发及基准评估方法。

items.title: What is an Agent Harness?
items.summary: Harness engineering is how we build systems around models to turn them into work engines. A harness is every piece of code, configuration, and execution logic that isn't the model itself. A raw model is not an agent, but can become one when a harness gives it things like state, tool execution, feedback loops, and enforceable constraints. Concretely, a harness includes things like: • System Prompts • Tools, Skills, MCPs + and their descriptions • Bundled Infrastructure (filesystem, sandbox, brows…
items.summary_zh: Agent Harness 是围绕模型构建的系统代码、配置与执行逻辑，提供状态、工具执行、反馈循环和可强制约束，使原始模型成为可工作的代理。
items.why_zh: 理解代理 harness 的组成与作用，学习如何为模型添加状态、工具、反馈与约束以构建可靠的 AI 系统。
